The '''bilinear quadrilateral element''', also known as the '''Q4 element''',<ref name="Zien00"/> is a type of element used in [[finite element analysis]] which is used to approximate in a 2D domain the exact solution to a given [[differential equation]].

The element consists of a combination of two sets of [[Lagrange polynomial]]s, each one used to define the variation of a field in each orthogonal direction of the local referential.
